# Fintech Disruption: Traditional Banking vs Digital Finance (2015–2024)

## Overview
Four datasets tracking the global shift from traditional banking to fintech-driven digital finance across four regions (North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin America) over a ten-year period from 2015 to 2024.

## Data Source

### digital_payment_penetration
Annual digital payment adoption rate as a percentage of the adult population. Fields: `year` (integer, 2015–2024), `region` (string, 4 categories), `penetration_pct` (float, 18.3–91.2%). Represents share of adults who made at least one digital payment transaction in the year.

### traditional_bank_branches
Total number of physical bank branch locations in thousands. Fields: `year` (integer, 2015–2024), `region` (string, 4 categories), `branches_k` (float, 58.6–315.8 thousand). Covers commercial and retail bank branches.

### neobank_users
Cumulative registered users of digital-only banks (neobanks) in millions. Fields: `year` (integer, 2016–2024), `region` (string, 4 categories), `users_m` (float, 0.8–498.3 million). Starts from 2016 when neobanks began gaining traction.

### digital_bank_licenses
Cumulative count of full digital banking licenses approved by national regulators. Fields: `year` (integer, 2015–2024), `region` (string, 4 categories), `cumulative_licenses` (integer, 0–85).

## Data Notes
- All figures are estimated composites across countries within each region
- Digital payment penetration includes mobile wallets, online banking transfers, and contactless card payments
- Neobank user counts include registered accounts; active user rates vary by region
- License counts reflect full banking licenses only, excluding e-money or payment institution licenses
- The 2020 spike in digital adoption reflects pandemic-accelerated behavioral shifts

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

import json

    data = json.load(f)

    'Asia-Pacific': '#C0392B',
    'Europe': '#2C3E80',
    'North America': '#2980B9',
    'Latin America': '#27AE60'

neobank_years = list(range(2016, 2025))

# Parse data into dicts

branches = {}
neobank = {}
licenses_cum = {}

for d in data['digital_payment_penetration']['data']:
    digital_payment[(d['year'], d['region'])] = d['penetration_pct']

for d in data['traditional_bank_branches']['data']:
    branches[(d['year'], d['region'])] = d['branches_k']

for d in data['neobank_users']['data']:
    neobank[(d['year'], d['region'])] = d['users_m']

for d in data['digital_bank_licenses']['data']:
    licenses_cum[(d['year'], d['region'])] = d['cumulative_licenses']

# =====================================================
# Create figure with 2x2 grid
# =====================================================

gs = fig.add_gridspec(2, 2, hspace=0.38, wspace=0.28,
                      left=0.06, right=0.96, top=0.89, bottom=0.06)

fig.suptitle('Fintech Disruption: The Great Banking Crossover (2015–2024)',
             fontsize=20, fontweight='bold', color='#1A1A2E', y=0.96)
fig.text(0.5, 0.925, 'Digital adoption surges as traditional infrastructure retreats — a structural shift accelerated by the pandemic',
         ha='center', fontsize=11, color='#555555', style='italic')

# =====================================================
# Panel 1: Crossover Dynamics (top-left) — Indexed chart
# =====================================================
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])

for region in regions:
    dp_values = [digital_payment[(y, region)] for y in years]
    dp_index = [v / dp_values[0] * 100 for v in dp_values]

    br_values = [branches[(y, region)] for y in years]
    br_index = [v / br_values[0] * 100 for v in br_values]

    ax1.plot(years, dp_index, color=colors[region], linewidth=2.8,
             marker='o', markersize=5, zorder=3)
    ax1.plot(years, br_index, color=colors[region], linewidth=2.2,
             linestyle='--', marker='s', markersize=3.5, alpha=0.65, zorder=2)

# Reference line at 100
ax1.axhline(y=100, color='#AAAAAA', linewidth=1, linestyle=':', alpha=0.6, zorder=1)

# Pandemic shading
ax1.axvspan(2019.5, 2020.5, alpha=0.10, color='#E74C3C', zorder=0)

             ha='center', color='#C0392B', fontstyle='italic', fontweight='bold')

# and branch index crosses below 100 (declines)
# Add visual annotation for divergence

             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='<->', color='#555555', lw=1.5))
ax1.text(2024.3, 122, 'Divergence\nwidening', fontsize=7.5, color='#555555',
         va='center', ha='left')

ax1.set_title('Digital Adoption vs. Branch Decline\n(Indexed: 2015 = 100)',
              fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=12, color='#1A1A2E')
ax1.set_xlabel('Year', fontsize=10, color='#333333')
ax1.set_ylabel('Index (2015 = 100)', fontsize=10, color='#333333')
ax1.set_xticks(years)
ax1.set_xticklabels([str(y) for y in years], fontsize=8, rotation=45)
ax1.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linewidth=0.5)
ax1.set_ylim(55, 185)
ax1.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax1.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

# Custom legend

    legend_elements.append(Line2D([0], [0], color=colors[region], linewidth=2.5, label=region))

legend_elements.append(Line2D([0], [0], color='#888888', linewidth=2.5, linestyle='--', label='Bank Branches'))

ax1.legend(handles=legend_elements, loc='upper left', fontsize=7.5, framealpha=0.95,
           edgecolor='#CCCCCC')

# =====================================================
# Panel 2: Branch Closure Acceleration (top-right)
# =====================================================

bar_width = 0.2
x_pos = np.arange(len(years) - 1)
year_labels = [f"'{str(years[j+1])[2:]}" for j in range(len(years) - 1)]

for i, region in enumerate(regions):
    br_values = [branches[(y, region)] for y in years]
    closures = [br_values[j] - br_values[j + 1] for j in range(len(years) - 1)]

            color=colors[region], alpha=0.88, label=region,
            edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)

idx_2019_20 = years.index(2020) - 1  # =4
ax2.axvspan(idx_2019_20 - 0.45, idx_2019_20 + 0.45, alpha=0.08, color='#E74C3C', zorder=0)

ax2.annotate('Sharp acceleration\n2019→2020', xy=(idx_2019_20, max_closure * 0.92),
             fontsize=8.5, ha='center', color='#C0392B', fontweight='bold',
             bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='#FDE8E8', edgecolor='#C0392B', alpha=0.9))

# Also highlight sustained period
ax2.annotate('', xy=(9, max_closure * 0.15), xytext=(4, max_closure * 0.15),
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#555555', lw=1.5))
ax2.text(6.5, max_closure * 0.20, 'Sustained high closure rate', fontsize=7.5,
         ha='center', color='#555555', fontstyle='italic')

ax2.set_title('Annual Bank Branch Closures by Region\n(Thousands of Locations Removed)',
              fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=12, color='#1A1A2E')
ax2.set_xlabel('Period', fontsize=10, color='#333333')
ax2.set_ylabel('Branch Closures (thousands)', fontsize=10, color='#333333')
ax2.set_xticks(x_pos)
ax2.set_xticklabels(year_labels, fontsize=8, rotation=45)
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linewidth=0.5)
ax2.legend(fontsize=7.5, loc='upper left', framealpha=0.95, edgecolor='#CCCCCC')
ax2.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax2.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

# Panel 3: Neobank User Surge (bottom-left)
# =====================================================

for region in regions:
    users = [neobank[(y, region)] for y in neobank_years]
    ax3.plot(neobank_years, users, color=colors[region], linewidth=2.8,

ax3.annotate('Asia-Pacific: 498M users\n(3.3× Europe by 2024)',

             fontsize=8.5, color='#C0392B', fontweight='bold',

ax3.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
